newsitem.title: LATVIA: BUDGET SURPLUS 21.5 MLN LATS BY JUNE 19.
newsitem.headline: BUDGET SURPLUS 21.5 MLN LATS BY JUNE 19.

text.p: Latvia's state budget surplus this year amounted to 21.54 million lats by June 19, the finance ministry said on Friday.
Revenues so far amounted to 267.39 million and expenditure reached 245.85 million lats, the ministry said in a statement.
It also said total state debt came to 419.07 million lats.
This was financed by state Treasury bills worth 135.86 million lats and IMF credits of 64.78 million lats as well as 62.51 million lats credits from the World Bank.
